name: The Refectory
why_it_matters: The dining room of The Himalayan castle resort — Victorian Gothic Revival turret with a coffered wooden ceiling and a vaulted veranda over apple orchards. Open to non-residents by reservation; the most architecturally distinctive dinner table in the Kullu valley.
insider_tip: Book the Conservatory side at sunset — the premier-floor windows frame the snow line above the orchard. The Dungeon Bar (in the eastern turret, Irish-pub styled) is the post-dinner move.

name: Riverside Restaurant
signature_dish: alfresco grill platter over the Beas
why_it_matters: The flagship dining room at Span Resort — opened 1981, one of the oldest luxury resorts in the valley. The deck overhangs the Beas at Katrain (mid-Kullu-Manali highway, 14 Mile post), so you eat to the sound of the river itself.
insider_tip: The bonfire-and-grill evening is the version locals book for; weekday off-season nights are the only time the deck isn't packed with weekenders out of Delhi.
signature_address: 14 Mile, P.O. Katrain, Kullu-Manali Highway, Manali 175129, Himachal Pradesh

name: Zing Zing Bar
signature_dish: single-malt flight with mountain bar bites
why_it_matters: Span's full-stocked bar — domestic and imported beers, Scotch single malts, tequila and bourbon, plus a Library Lounge & Café for espresso. Named after the Zing Zing Bar staging post on the Manali-Leh highway, but indoors and centrally heated.
insider_tip: Pair the bar with the poolside bar in summer, or move to the Library Lounge in winter — the centrally heated indoor option non-residents rarely think to ask for.
signature_address: 14 Mile, P.O. Katrain, Kullu-Manali Highway, Manali 175129, Himachal Pradesh

name: Kibber
area: Manuallaya The Resort & Spa, Sunny Side, Chadiyari
why_it_matters: The signature Indian room at Manuallaya — fort-styled interior named after the high-Spiti village, hand-ground spice masalas, slow-cooked north-Indian and Mughlai. The most elaborate hotel-restaurant set-piece on the Vashisht side of Manali.
insider_tip: Order the kashmiri pulao with the rogan josh — the kitchen is openly proud of the lamb here. Library Bar after dinner has the rare-single-malt list other Manali hotels don't bother stocking.
signature_address: Sunny Side, Chadiyari, Vashisht Road, Manali 175103, Himachal Pradesh

name: D'Jong
area: Manuallaya The Resort & Spa, Sunny Side, Chadiyari
why_it_matters: Manuallaya's pan-Asian counterpart to Kibber — far-east flavours plated with the resort's contemporary décor. One of the few Manali hotel restaurants that takes wok-cooking seriously rather than treating it as buffet filler.
insider_tip: If you're staying elsewhere, call ahead — D'Jong rotates between fixed dinner service and full a-la-carte depending on occupancy. Thukpa is the move on a cold-weather night.
signature_address: Sunny Side, Chadiyari, Vashisht Road, Manali 175103, Himachal Pradesh

name: Dhaam
why_it_matters: Named after the Himachali word for a community feast — the all-day room at Solang Valley Resort plates the regional canon properly: Tudkiya Bhaat, Chha Gosht, Laal Rajma, grilled trout from the Beas-system streams. The most legible Himachali-cuisine pitch in the Solang stretch.
insider_tip: Order the Kulluvi Dham (the multi-course Kullu-valley thali) once during your stay — it's a sit-down format you won't find on the Mall Road versions.
signature_address: V.P.O. Palchan, Solang Road, Manali 175131, Himachal Pradesh

name: The Gazebo
why_it_matters: Solang Valley Resort's Italian counterpart to Dhaam — a wood-fired oven driving the menu, and trout from the Beas system grilled or topping a pizza. One of the few hotel kitchens in Manali that actually fires its own pizzas, not heats them.
insider_tip: Ask for the trout pizza — it's the dish the kitchen plates as a signature crossover between Italian technique and local fish. The Malana bar adjoins for a post-dinner drink.
signature_address: V.P.O. Palchan, Solang Road, Manali 175131, Himachal Pradesh

name: The Orchard (Apple Country Resorts)
area: Apple Country Resorts, Log Huts Area
why_it_matters: Apple Country brands itself "a vegetarian place" and means it — the in-house restaurant The Orchard is fully pure-veg, including the breakfast spread. The largest dedicated pure-veg luxury kitchen in central Manali.
insider_tip: Non-resident bookings are accepted; veg families touring Manali use this as the lunch stop because the Mall Road veg options are weaker. South Indian breakfast counter is the surprise.
signature_address: Log Huts Area, Manali 175131, Himachal Pradesh

name: Larisa Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: Set on the Kullu-Naggar-Manali road in Haripur — apple-orchard property along the Beas. Known for the curated Kulluvi Dham (multi-course local thali) and bookable private orchard dining under bonfire warmth.
insider_tip: The orchard dinner is a separate booking, not part of the buffet — request it at check-in or 24 hours ahead. It's the version of Manali fine-dining outsiders rarely think to ask for.
signature_address: Kullu-Naggar-Manali Road, Haripur, Manali 175136, Himachal Pradesh

name: Cafe Buransh
why_it_matters: Named after Buransh, the rhododendron tree native to the Kullu hills. The Orchard Greens' restaurant runs a live-counter format — visible kitchen action with custom orders to the chef — which most centrally-heated mid-luxury Manali resorts don't bother with.
insider_tip: The lavish breakfast buffet with live counters is open to walk-ins on quiet days; call ahead to confirm. The pizza and tandoor counters are stronger than the Indian gravy section.
signature_address: The Orchard Greens Resort, Manali 175131, Himachal Pradesh

name: Valley View Restaurant (Snow Valley Resorts)
area: Snow Valley Resorts, Log Huts Area / Mall Road area
why_it_matters: The main multi-cuisine room at Snow Valley Resorts — large windowed dining over the valley, with The Terrace rooftop café and The Orchard for outdoor seating. One of the few Manali hotels that lists Gujarati on its full menu (the property leans into Gujarati family bookings).
insider_tip: Skip the formal dining room and ask for The Terrace rooftop in shoulder-season afternoons — packed lunches are also offered for guests heading out to Solang or Rohtang.
signature_address: Snow Valley Resorts, Manali 175131, Himachal Pradesh
